relationships.toka-todo: Explains Tendo's gravity and prevents Toka from joining the first Daien operation; later leaves her in Kyushu under evacuation command.

relationships.harima-tendo: Would have been a main attacker with World Crisis before the U.S. attack forced her recall.

periods.summary: Kurono reaches Kyushu after Tendo's first catastrophe and leads the planned Daien討伐 meeting. She explains Awakening, Desperado, Excessive Awakening, Tendo's spirit body, and the limited attack methods likely to work: her World Crisis and Moroboshi's Tiger Bite. She notices Toka's mental instability and bars her from the operation after Toka experiences death-visions from Tendo's gravity. When the U.S. Pacific Fleet invades, Itsuki orders Kurono back to Tokyo; she reluctantly accepts because Enterprise could devastate the capital. In Tokyo Bay she is delivered by Kirihara and Kagami under invisibility, corrodes carrier groups with Clock on Death, and then engages Douglas Upton's giant Device Enterprise, preventing it from landing.

key_events.summary: Chairs the Daien operation meeting and explains Desperado/Excessive Awakening.
Accepts the order to abandon the immediate Kyushu attack and defend the capital.
Destroys ships with time acceleration and begins fighting Upton's Enterprise.

abilities: time acceleration movement and combat command
